def Expr.diff : Expr → Expr
  | .const _ => .const 0
  | .x => .const 1
  | .t => .const 0
  | .root => .mul (.mul .x .t) .invRoot
  | .invRoot => .mul (.const (-1)) (.mul (.mul .x .t) (Expr.invRoot.pow 3))
  | .jet k => .mul (.jet (k + 1)) (Expr.invRoot.pow 3)
  | .add e f => .add e.diff f.diff
  | .mul e f => .add (.mul e.diff f) (.mul e f.diff)
